name: IF
hint: a when the test is true, else b.

name: IFS
hint: The value of the first test that is true.

name: SWITCH
hint: The value of the first key that equals x; the last value is the default.

name: AND
hint: True when every test is true.

name: OR
hint: True when one test is true.

name: NOT
hint: The opposite of the test.

name: IFERROR
hint: alt when x is blank.

name: ISBLANK
hint: True when the value is blank.

name: BLANK
hint: A blank value.

name: ABS
hint: The number without its sign.

name: ROUND
hint: Rounds to n places.

name: ROUNDUP
hint: Rounds away from zero.

name: ROUNDDOWN
hint: Rounds toward zero.

name: INT
hint: Rounds down to a whole number.

name: MOD
hint: The rest of a divided by b.

name: POWER
hint: a to the power of b.

name: SQRT
hint: The square root.

name: EXP
hint: e to the power of x.

name: LN
hint: The natural logarithm.

name: LOG10
hint: The logarithm to base 10.

name: MIN
hint: The smaller of two or more values.

name: MAX
hint: The larger of two or more values.

name: DIVIDE
hint: a divided by b; alt when b is zero.

name: CONCAT
hint: Joins text, like &.

name: LEFT
hint: The first n characters.

name: RIGHT
hint: The last n characters.

name: MID
hint: n characters from position start.

name: LEN
hint: The number of characters.

name: UPPER
hint: Capital letters.

name: LOWER
hint: Small letters.

name: PROPER
hint: A capital letter at the start of each word.

name: TRIM
hint: Removes extra spaces.

name: SUBSTITUTE
hint: Replaces every old with new.

name: FIND
hint: Where find starts in text; case matters.

name: SEARCH
hint: Where find starts in text; case does not matter.

name: VALUE
hint: Reads text as a number.

name: DATE
hint: Builds a date.

name: YEAR
hint: The year of a date.

name: MONTH
hint: The month of a date, 1 to 12.

name: DAY
hint: The day of the month.

name: WEEKDAY
hint: 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday.

name: WEEKNUM
hint: The ISO week number.

name: QUARTER
hint: The quarter, 1 to 4.

name: FISCALYEAR
hint: The year by the workspace's calendar: a year that starts in April 2026 is 2027.

name: FISCALQUARTER
hint: The quarter, 1 to 4, counted from the month the workspace's year starts in.

name: EOMONTH
hint: The last day of the month, some months later.

name: EDATE
hint: The same day, some months later.

name: DATEDIF
hint: Days ("D"), months ("M") or years ("Y") between two dates.

name: DAYS
hint: The days from start to end.

name: TODAY
hint: Today's date, as of when the view was built.

name: NOW
hint: The date and time, as of when the view was built.

name: SUM
hint: The sum of a column.

name: AVERAGE
hint: The mean of a column.

name: COUNT
hint: How many numbers or dates are filled.

name: COUNTA
hint: How many values are filled.

name: COUNTD
hint: How many different values.

name: MEDIAN
hint: The middle value.

name: PERCENTILE
hint: The value below which the share p of the rows lie.

name: STDEV
hint: The spread of the values, on the sample.

name: VAR
hint: The variance of the values, on the sample.

name: SUMIF
hint: The sum of x where the test is true.

name: COUNTIF
hint: How many filled values of x where the test is true.

name: AVERAGEIF
hint: The mean of x where the test is true.

name: COUNTROWS
hint: The number of rows of a table.

name: PARAM
hint: A parameter's value, by its name in double quotes. Measures only.
